notes.title: v1.2.0 Update (New game mode + QOL)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=c1aqozMGZ5g;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone!

We present the [strike]Nostalgia[/strike] [b]Welcome To the Chain Reaction[/b] update!

It's been a long time since we last met and i hope you're all still carrying your Last Message with you in case a [strike]zombie [/strike]zed bite!

Over the past couple years we've been cooking up a small quality of life update with many fixes, updates and a [b]new game mode[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D3gf1aXZWiA&t=314
[url=https://jamesgamesbro.itch.io/welcome-to-the-chain-reaction]Welcome to the Chain Reaction[/url] is the game that started the life of Last Message ([b]WAY back in 2019![/b]). This video meant the world to us and we wanted to keep the memory of the game by sprucing it up and bring it in as free bonus content for everyone to enjoy!

Also since the release of Last Message we've been enjoying many videos and comments and noticed some requests from those of you that played and we hope these changes help refine the experience for more people that wish to enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331890/9b4c74b6aeb0453cec2c2add7a36bfd40ee7aff6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331890/804309b02b044d286d4b656a6e5d682694dffa60.png[/img]

[h2]Added[/h2]
- Added new game mode (Welcome to the Chain reaction)
- Added outline for anything that can be interacted with
- Added hand models when holding items
- Added UI showing what you're holding
- Added warning window when exiting the game due to no save system
- Added option to change controls
- Added basic task list to pause menu


[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Improved settings menu with more options and tooltips.
- Updated credits for those that tested the game and helped with retrospective video
- Changed model of screwdriver to have blood on it
- Improved splash screen and loading screen (less boring)
- Flashlight now has real time shadows
- Disabled HDR (Fixes lighting blown out of proportion on monitors with HDR)
- Cursor now changes to a grab image when hovering over something interactable
- Minor changes to world
- Small Audio balances
- Adjusted Yak chat to be slightly faster and touched up some text.


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Lighting blinding the player when using an HDR monitor
- Fixed not being able to speed up credits screen with movement buttons
- Fixed read emails showing as too dark and being missed in playthroughs
- Fixed no animation of player leaving the wardrobe
- Fixed "Press F for flashlight" prompt never disappearing unless player presses F
- Fixed no notification when options appear on Yak

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update (More zeds, bug fixes and QOL)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since releasing Last Message we have been keeping an eye out for videos, streams and  reviews. From what we have seen, most feedback is leaning on the positive side!

We are absolutely blown away with everyone’s reviews and playthroughs and could not be more thankful to those that have shared their experiences playing Last Message. Every post greatly inspires us and we have taken all feedback onboard, will to continue learning, make great games and consider where to take Last Message next.

We have been working in our spare time to update the game with fixes to solve game breaking problems, small inconveniences and adding some nice-to-have changes that we didn’t have time for prior to release.

While investigating some black screen issues we discovered that it was an issue on particular Macs. Unfortunately we are unable to test on a Mac on a daily basis. [u]To focus our efforts on what we can do well we will no longer support Mac.[/u]

[*] Key in lobby now has a new model

[/olist]

[b]Fixed:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]

[*] Car outside now shows a car alarm and alerts nearby zeds

[/olist]

notes.title: March Development Update
notes.content:
Hello again!
Great to see you :D

March was crazy with a lot happening.


[b]Award Nomination[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331890/8afbc455bda966dd237cdad0189d5f0e03ce731f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331890/218ec2c3a22416936fd7268ad85787f692a642c3.jpg[/img]

We are all absolutely thrilled about this and began working hard preparing for the event by updating the demo to a much more polished version.


[b]Patch 0.3.0[/b]
We have been working hard preparing for the event by updating the demo to version 0.3.0 with bug fixes, additional content and much more polish.

[list]
[*]Balanced and fixed audio
[*]Added flashlight tutorial prompt when in a dark area
[*]Every tutorial prompt now has it's own icon indicating which button to press.
[*]Updated washing line box model
[*]Lowered Henrys curtain so it can no longer be seen from the washing line
[*]People page: Redone with unique comments on each page
[*]People page: Added friends list to to make it easier to navigate between profiles
[*]Yak: Improved chat logs
[*]Can now run using 'Shift'
[*]Player head bob animation
[/list]

[b]New release date[/b]
With all the excitement we will also be delaying the release of the game until June. We believe this extra time will help produce a more rewarding ending to the game. 

[b]Progress[/b]
We haven't been able to make much in-game progress to the full game - but have a good plan to get it done as soon as possible.
Some things we have done is write out a good plan for the end of the story and are now ready to start implementing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331890/757b979574cf95e2f173f2ec0786399ff4764a68.png[/img]
One additional thing we have done is start an implementation to add mod support through the steam workshop.


Until next time

Cheers,
The team at James Games
